generationSettingsDescription.message: Configure text response generation parameters for selected model

generationParam_temperature_desc.message: Controls response randomness. Low values (0.2) make responses more predictable, high values (1.5+) make them more creative

generationParam_top_p_desc.message: Model selects words from top-X% by probability. For example, 0.9 = top-90%. Recommended to use either Temperature or Top P

generationParam_top_k_desc.message: Limits choice to K most probable words. Value 0 disables this parameter

generationParam_frequency_penalty_desc.message: Reduces probability of selecting a word based on how often it's already been used. Helps avoid repetition

generationParam_presence_penalty_desc.message: Penalizes words simply for being in the text. Encourages more diverse vocabulary

generationParam_repetition_penalty_desc.message: General parameter for reducing repetitions. Value 1.0 changes nothing, above 1.0 reduces repetition

generationParam_min_p_desc.message: Sets minimum probability threshold for tokens relative to most probable token

generationParam_top_a_desc.message: Advanced sampling method that dynamically filters tokens with insufficiently high probability

generationParam_seed_desc.message: For generating deterministic responses. Same seed will give same result (not guaranteed for all models)

generationParam_max_tokens_desc.message: Maximum number of tokens to generate. Helps control response length

generationParam_stop_desc.message: Comma-separated list of strings. Generation will stop when any is encountered

generationParam_response_format_desc.message: Allows forcing output format. JSON requires mention in prompt

imageQualityDescription.message: Higher quality requires more tokens and time

helpPageSubtitle.message: Learn about all the features of AiLex extension

helpDescription_aiProviders.message: Support for various AI providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Grok, Gemini, and LM Studio. You can choose any provider and model from an extensive list. Each provider is configured separately with its own API key and the ability to specify a custom endpoint for self-hosted models.

helpDescription_modelFilters.message: Powerful model filtering system by context length, input and output modalities (text, image, file), and AI operators. Filters are saved automatically and display the number of models found. Perfect for quickly finding the right model among hundreds of available options.

helpDescription_sitePrompts.message: Smart ready-made queries that automatically appear depending on the type of page you're viewing. For Amazon - review analysis, for YouTube - video summary with timestamps, for articles - brief overview. Each prompt automatically activates necessary functions: page context, web search, or video transcription.

helpDescription_fullscreenMode.message: ChatGPT-like interface with sidebar, chat and folder management. Automatic synchronization with sidepanel, chat creation on first message, chat search and folder grouping. All external links open in new tabs, and URL syncs with current chatId.

helpDescription_messageEditing.message: Ability to compare answers from different models in one block with pagination.

helpDescription_messageConsul.message: Get a summary response from selected model based on all responses

helpDescription_fileAttachments.message: Support for documents (PDF, DOC, DOCX), code (JS, TS, PY, etc.) and data (JSON, CSV, XML). Text files are read as text, binary files are converted to Base64. Automatic model support checking with preview and history saving. Size limit: 10 MB.

helpDescription_screenshotCapture.message: Interactive screen area selection with darkening and highlighting of the selected zone. Automatic image compression when limit is exceeded. Cancel selection via Esc or click on input field. Result is saved as an image with support for multimodal models.

helpDescription_tabMentions.message: Powerful feature for comparing information from multiple pages. Type @ in the input field to select open browser tabs (up to 5). Filter by name, current domain priority, visual badges with icons. Perfect for price comparison, competitor analysis, or fact-checking.

helpDescription_voiceInput.message: Speech recognition via Web Speech API in a separate popup with beautiful UI. Automatic recording start, dark and light theme support, visual process indication. Continuous recognition with real-time text preview and automatic addition to input field.

helpDescription_webcamCapture.message: Device camera activation with preview before capture. Browser permission handling, automatic compression and photo saving. Support for multimodal models with AI image analysis capability. Photos are saved in history and can be reused.

helpDescription_functionCalling.message: Tool system with automatic AI function calling based on context. Support for recursive calls (up to 5 iterations), built-in and custom tools, 40+ DOM functions. Visual indication with green highlighting and stop button. Full integration with OpenRouter and Anthropic.

helpDescription_summarizeContacts.message: Extracting page text content to create a summary. Automatic contact collection: email, phones, Telegram using regular expressions. Support for different output formats: text, JSON, CSV. Display of found contacts count.

helpDescription_formFilling.message: Two-step process: AI analyzes form fields and automatically matches them with personal information from settings. Support for all field types: text, email, tel, textarea, select. Smart field search by id, name, placeholder with report on filled fields.

helpDescription_pageParsing.message: Automatic data extraction from multiple pages. AI finds CSS selectors by description, traverses links and collects data. Smart filtering of relevant links, JSON/CSV/text formats. Visual indication with progress bar, hang protection and pause after 20 pages.

helpDescription_textContextMenu.message: 24 commands in 6 categories for processing selected text: analysis, editing, research, education, translation, and combined. Automatic localization, some commands activate web search. Save quotes in chat history and smart addition to current dialog.

helpDescription_fieldContextMenu.message: Intelligent field filling with AI: generate responses in different tones (professional, friendly, direct), process by instruction, instant personal data insertion. AI analyzes page context and generates text in page language without opening the extension.

helpDescription_chatHistory.message: History of all dialogs grouped by days: Today, Yesterday, N days ago. Site information with quick navigation, icons of used operators, token count. Pagination of 30 chats per page with navigation. Click on chat automatically opens site and loads history.

helpDescription_tokenStatistics.message: Detailed usage analytics with filters by periods and operators. Charts: token dynamics by day, distribution by AI operators, top-10 models. Overall metrics of messages and tokens for the period. All data is automatically saved to IndexedDB with each request.

helpDescription_exportImport.message: Backup of all extension settings: API keys (decrypted), models, theme, language, personal information, instructions. Data validation, selective import of needed sections, error handling. Perfect for transferring between computers or sharing configurations.

helpDescription_developerMode.message: API request debugging panel without DevTools. Display of all calls in real-time: timestamps, headers (with key masking), request and response body with JSON formatting. Interactive interface with data copying, color indication, and storage of up to 200 entries in IndexedDB.

sitePrompt_youtube_video_4.message: Write down the words for review from the language video with example sentences.

helpDescription_groupChat.message: Group chat with multiple models. You can select the models you want to use for the chat.

helpDescription_chatInstructions.message:
In the extension settings, you can specify general instructions, as well as plug-in instructions that will be added when requested by AI. In the instructions, you can set roles, tone and format of response, and other additional conditions. 

You can also specify instructions for specific sites, to which these instructions will be automatically applied.
